This is a list of themes that have been played in the {{pmin|the Netherlands|Dutch}} dub of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. The openings of season 3, 4 and 8-present were originally dubbed into Dutch. The openings of season 2, 5, 6 and 7 were never dubbed and therefore have no official Dutch version. The first opening was dubbed in Pokémon X & Y and the [[M20|20th movie]].
